contract.goal: A claim-by-claim accuracy review of the supplied content: every checkable claim rated true, false, misleading or unverifiable against cited evidence, each inaccuracy corrected with its source, and an overall trust rating.

deliverables.description: The accuracy review: the overall trust rating with counts by verdict, every claim with its verdict and evidence, a correction and source for each inaccuracy, and the sources consulted

criteria.text: The review is a full document organized under section headings
The content under review was opened and read before it was judged
Each claim carries a verdict: true, false, misleading or unverifiable

checks.label: claim verdicts on the true/false/misleading/unverifiable scale

criteria.text: It gives an overall trust rating for the content
It lists every source consulted in a Sources section
Its verdicts and corrections cite their evidence, and every cited file exists
Every number, date and quote given as evidence or as a correction appears in the source it cites; restating the reviewed content is fine
Every checkable claim in the content is addressed, and a claim no reliable source settles is marked unverifiable rather than assumed true

judge.rubric: Does the review address every checkable claim in the content, and mark claims without reliable evidence as unverifiable instead of accepting them as true?

criteria.text: Inaccuracies come first, each false or misleading claim gives the correct statement with its source, and the trust rating matches the findings

judge.rubric: Does every false or misleading claim get a correct statement backed by a cited source, and does the overall trust rating follow from the verdicts?
